fluid.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook, water at 300 K and 0.101325 MPa (IAPWS-95, Wagner and Pruss 2002; viscosity Huber et al. 2009)

geometries.label: (6,6) carbon nanotube, 2.46 nm long
geometries.diameterConvention: carbon-centre diameter a*sqrt(n^2+nm+m^2)/pi, a = sqrt(3) * 0.1420 nm
geometries.accessibleConvention: carbon-centre diameter minus 0.340 nm (carbon van der Waals diameter); label only
geometries.lengthConvention: ten armchair unit cells (recorded segment length 24.5951 Å)
geometries.lattice: square, centres at ((i+1/2)s, (j+1/2)s), far-edge strips without pores

recordedTrajectory.label: Recorded CP2K ab initio MD (PBE-D3(BJ), NVT 300 K, 0.75 ps): periodic (6,6) segment with 6 water molecules, one Na+ and one Cl-. Structure only; it does not respond to pressure and is not the pure-water system of the pore law.

provenance.statement: Declared input scenario. G = 1.0e-27 m^3 Pa^-1 s^-1 corresponds to 3.33 water molecules per ns at a driving potential of 100 MPa. It is not a measured property of water in a (6,6) carbon nanotube and carries no uncertainty.
provenance.lengthDependence: unsupported; only the declared tube length is accepted
provenance.includes: entrance, interior, exit and access resistance of one pore, lumped
provenance.calibrationStatus: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: no pure-water pressure-flow measurement for this geometry yet (tools/continuum/md-calibration/README.md)

device.portSide: 0.2 * min(W, B), centred on the outer faces (one patch wide)

pressure.convention: outlet-referenced: permeate port face at 0.101325 MPa, feed port face at 0.101325 MPa + dP

device.patchSide: 0.2 * min(W, B): 5 patches across the shorter side
device.fineMeshRule: Fine mesh: 40 cells across the shorter side when min(W, B)/(10 nm) is divisible by 40, otherwise 50, so that every continuum face holds whole lattice rows
device.resolutionCheck: every result is compared with the same configuration at a second mesh level (10 cells across the shorter side for the standard mesh, 20 for a fine mesh); the total-flow resolution passes when |dQ|/Q <= 0.02; level 10 is used only for this comparison
